title: 第9章 啰嗦1章 还是没换上黑丝第10章 一言不合拆了
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
“天，天穹境！
只记录在古籍中的境界，今天亲眼见到了。”
大皇子目瞪口呆的看到被柳雨柔一拳废掉了两人，吓出一身冷汗，自己的感觉是对的还好从始至终没有出手，不然现在躺在地上的就不只两个人了。
“嗯，力道控制得还行，还吊着口气。”
青墨显现原本容貌，走到两人身前：“人生有很多捷径，你们偏偏选最快的这条。”
说完右手打了个响指出现一块光幕，幕中正是冥阳宗，青墨对着光幕中的冥阳宗轻轻挥了衣袖，整个冥阳宗包括宗门所在山峦全部化为飞灰。
“其实你嘴里冥阳宗的宝物，我真看不上。”
在场的所有人看着青墨的手段，全部头皮发麻大气都不敢喘一下，生怕这位大佬一不开心反手一巴掌把自己老家给拍没了。
“雨柔，这寂灭法则之力，想不想学？”
“嗯！
嗯！
嗯！
主人人家要学～”
柳雨柔疯狂的点头大眼睛一闪一闪的看着青墨，之觉得跟着这样的主人真是太幸运了。
“先把事情做完，回头我慢慢教你”
“好的，主人”
柳雨柔提着林家主的脚，把他拖回紫霜城。
冥阳宗已经没了，冥阳宗大长老也重伤垂死，
青墨玩味的看向西海断念宫圣女，之前他就感觉到断念宫圣女的气息有一丝丝与自己因果相连，可能她以前触碰或是遇到自己需要的东西才会沾染上气息。
老头给自己的玉佩上面说明此方世界有五个天材地宝是自己需要找到的，西海肯定要去一趟。

“这位前辈，我们和林家主冥阳宗大长老不是一伙的，从始至终都没有出手，只是好奇才过来一探究竟，请前辈见谅”
一个美艳熟妇突然从暗中出现急忙说到，态度放得很低，生怕一个不注意给断念宫带来灭顶之灾。
青墨静静看着美艳熟妇，一身白衣，合道境初期的实力，身材比柳雨柔丝毫不差，更有一种无法言喻的韵味，胸前规模仿佛要突破衣服的束缚一般，拱手行礼时都能看到那无尽的沟渠令人遐想！
“曹操虽死，曹贼永存。
丞相，我悟到了”
“宿主你悟到啥了？”
“我悟到了曹操的想法，才理解他的眼光是多么的独到！”
“是那个治世之能臣，乱世之枭雄？他的想法不就是一统中原吗？这又啥的？明眼人都看得出来”
“系统啊！
你不懂，你就是个没有感情的统子，你理解不了魏武雄风对于我们年轻人的含义！”
“啥含义？”
“挨……懒得和你说，说了你也听不懂”
青墨内心有点小高兴，脸上还是不动声色的发问。
“你叫什么名字？还有你们圣女叫什么？”
“晚辈名叫寒千雪，我宗圣女名叫沈云容。”
“人美名字也好听，寒千雪，沈云容，不错不错”
两人听到前辈对自己的评价，脸上出现一些红晕。
“再过不久本公子会去西海走一趟，到时会交代你们点事情，办好了就赐你们机缘。”
content_en:
“Heaven, the sky realm!
The realm that was only recorded in ancient books was seen with my own eyes today. "
The eldest prince was stunned to see Liu Yurou destroying the two of them with one punch, and broke into a cold sweat. He felt that he was right. Fortunately, he did not take action from the beginning to the end, otherwise there would be more than two people lying on the ground now.
"Well, I can control my strength quite well, and I can still hold my breath."
Qing Mo showed his original appearance and walked up to the two of them: "There are many shortcuts in life, but you just choose the fastest one."
After speaking, he snapped his fingers with his right hand and a light screen appeared. In the screen was the Mingyang Sect. Qing Mo waved his sleeves gently at the Mingyang Sect in the light screen. The entire Mingyang Sect, including the mountains where the sect was located, were all turned into ashes.
"Actually, I really don't like the treasure of Mingyang Sect in your mouth."
Everyone present looked at Qing Mo's methods, their scalps were numb and they didn't dare to take a breath, for fear that the boss would slap his hometown away with his backhand if he was unhappy.
"Yurou, do you want to learn the power of the Law of Annihilation?"
"Hmm!
Well!
Well!
Master, I need to learn~"
Liu Yurou nodded crazily and looked at Qing Mo with her big eyes flashing, feeling that she was so lucky to follow such a master.
"Finish the work first, and I will teach you slowly later."
"Okay, Master"
Liu Yurou took the head of the Lin family by his feet and dragged him back to Zishuang City.
The Mingyang Sect is gone, and the Great Elder of the Mingyang Sect is also seriously injured and dying.
Qing Mo looked at the Saint of the Xihai Duan Nian Palace in a playful way. He had felt before that the aura of the Saint of the Duan Nian Palace was causally connected to his own. Maybe she was contaminated by her aura when she touched or encountered something he needed in the past.
The jade pendant the old man gave him stated that there were five treasures of heaven and earth in this world that he needed to find, and he must go to Xihai.
"Senior, we are not in the same group as the Lin Family Master, the Great Elder of Mingyang Sect. We have never taken any action from the beginning to the end. We just came here out of curiosity to find out. Senior, please forgive me."
A beautiful mature woman suddenly appeared from the darkness and spoke hurriedly, her attitude was very low, for fear that if she didn't pay attention, she would bring disaster to the Suan Nian Palace.
Qing Mo looked at the beautiful mature woman quietly. She was dressed in white. Her strength was at the early stage of the Hedao realm. Her figure was no worse than Liu Yurou's, and she had an indescribable charm. The size of her chest seemed to break through the constraints of her clothes. When she bowed her hands and saluted, she could see the endless ditch that made people daydream!
“Although Cao Cao is dead, Cao Cao’s thieves will live on forever.
Prime Minister, I understand.”
"Host, what have you realized?"
"After I realized Cao Cao's thoughts, I understood how unique his vision is!"
"Is he that capable minister who governs the world, the hero in troubled times? Isn't his idea just to unify the Central Plains? What does that mean? Anyone with a discerning eye can see it."
"System!
You don’t understand, you are just an emotionless Tongzi, you can’t understand what Wei Wu Xiongfeng means to our young people! "
"What does it mean?"
"I... I'm too lazy to tell you, and you won't understand even if I tell you."
Qing Mo was a little happy in his heart, but still asked questions calmly on his face.
"What's your name? And what's the name of your saint?"
"This junior's name is Han Qianxue, and the name of our saint is Shen Yunrong."
"She is a beautiful person with a nice name, Han Qianxue, Shen Yunrong, not bad, not bad."
The two blushed slightly when they heard their senior's comments about themselves.
"Soon, my master will go to the West Sea for a trip. Then I will tell you something. Once done, I will give you a chance."
